sahneler.metin: The world's first jet airliner broke apart over the sea.
All thirty five people aboard died.
Then another Comet fell from the sky months later.
Investigators pressurized a whole Comet in a water tank, again and again.
The cabin split open at a sharp corner in the roof.
Every flight had stretched the metal, until fatigue cracked it.
Since then, jets have rounded windows and fatigue-tested fuselages.

aciklama:
Comet broke apart in flight. The cause: metal fatigue from repeated pressurisation concentrated at sharp cut-out corners.
